issues.t: Electronic door handles stop opening the doors
issues.sym: Tapping the outside door pad does nothing, often on the driver's door first. It may work on and off before failing, and some owners can only get in through another door. Inside release buttons can also stop working.
issues.why: The CT5 uses electronic door releases. The touch pad switch and its circuit board lose contact, and replacement handles have failed again on some cars.
issues.next: Learn the mechanical backup release in the owner's manual. Have the dealer replace the handle while under warranty, and keep records in case it repeats.

issues.sym: Harsh, delayed or slipping shifts, shudder, a 'reduced power' or 'drive with care' message, a sudden shift to neutral, or the car refusing to move in any gear.
issues.why: The control valve body in the 10-speed automatic fails. GM added a special coverage program (N242480631) for the valve body on many of these cars; some transmissions also suffered pump gear damage.
issues.next: Stop and get a tow if the car loses drive. Ask the dealer whether special coverage N242480631 and recall 25V-148 apply to your VIN.

issues.t: Transmission damage can lock the rear wheels (recall)
issues.sym: Harsh shifts or transmission warnings, and in rare cases the wheels locking up while driving.
issues.why: Internal damage in the 10-speed automatic can lock the transmission. The recall adds software that watches for the problem and limits it.
issues.next: Get the free recall software. If you see a transmission warning, slow down gently and pull over.

issues.sym: A 'Steering assist reduced, drive with care' message, steering that feels much heavier, or the wheel pulling or jerking in turns.
issues.why: The electric power steering system sets a fault and cuts back its assist.
issues.next: Grip the wheel firmly and slow down. Have the dealer read the steering codes promptly.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may be installed wrong (recall)
issues.why: The roof-rail curtain airbags may not have been installed correctly and might not deploy properly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls. The dealer inspects and reinstalls both curtain airbags for free.

issues.t: Daytime running lights stay on with headlights (recall)
issues.sym: The daytime running lights stay on at full brightness with the headlights on, causing glare for other drivers.
issues.why: A body control module software error.
issues.next: Accept the over-the-air update or have the dealer update the software for free.

issues.sym: A hard brake pedal that needs much more force, and brake warning messages.
issues.why: A contaminated sensor connection in the electronic brake booster can interrupt communication and cut power assist.
issues.next: Get the free brake boost module replacement. Leave extra stopping distance until it's done.

issues.t: Airbag warning light may not work correctly (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag light may come on and off inconsistently or fail to warn of a real fault.
issues.why: The communications gateway module doesn't handle a lost connection with the airbag module correctly.
issues.next: Accept the over-the-air update or have the dealer update the software for free.

issues.t: 'Service restraint system' warning from failed airbag sensor
issues.sym: A 'Service Restraint System' message stays on. Airbags may not work as intended until it is fixed.
issues.why: A driver-side airbag sensor fails. Owners report the part being on backorder.
issues.next: Have the dealer read the airbag codes and order the sensor under warranty. Ask for a loaner if parts are delayed.

issues.t: Backup camera shows a blue screen or error
issues.sym: A blue screen or camera error appears instead of the backup view, and it can keep coming back.
issues.why: Faults in the video processing module, camera wiring or radio. Some cars needed several parts replaced.
issues.next: Have the dealer diagnose it under warranty. Use mirrors and look back carefully until fixed.

issues.t: Driver-assist features unavailable or warning lights on
issues.sym: Forward collision, lane keeping or other driver-assist warnings appear and the features stop working.
issues.why: Software and camera faults. GM issued a software update bulletin for some cars, and others needed new cameras.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check for software updates and camera calibration.

issues.sym: A loud bang and broken sunroof glass with nothing hitting it, sometimes at highway speed.
issues.why: Owners report the panoramic sunroof glass breaking on its own.
issues.next: Pull over safely, close the shade and cover the opening. Have the glass replaced and ask the dealer to file a report with GM.

issues.t: Gas smell from leaking fuel line at the engine
issues.sym: A gasoline smell when the car starts.
issues.why: A fuel hose leaked at its connection near the engine.
issues.next: Don't drive if you smell fuel. Have it towed and the fuel line inspected.

issues.t: Brakes drag and overheat from failed brake control module
issues.sym: The brakes drag, you may smell hot brakes, and the wheels get very hot.
issues.why: The electronic brake control module failed and kept the brakes applied. The dealer recommended replacing the brakes too.
issues.next: Pull over safely and let the brakes cool. Have the car towed to the dealer.

issues.t: Water collects inside doors and trunk
issues.sym: Water sits inside the doors and trunk moldings after heavy rain or a car wash.
issues.why: Blocked drains or poor sealing let water collect instead of draining out.
issues.next: Have the dealer check the door and trunk drains and seals before rust starts.

issues.t: Wrong speed limit shown on the display
issues.sym: The dash shows the wrong speed limit, such as 55 mph on slower roads.
issues.why: The speed-limit display relies on map data that can be wrong.
issues.next: Always go by posted signs. Ask the dealer about map or software updates.

issues.sym: Rough idle, reduced power, check engine light, and transmission or valve timing service messages, leading to engine failure in the first few thousand miles.
issues.why: A few new cars have needed a complete engine replacement early on; the cause wasn't reported.
issues.next: Stop driving if the engine runs rough with warnings. The powertrain warranty covers this; get it towed to a dealer.

issues.t: Automatic braking activates with nothing ahead
issues.sym: The car brakes hard on the highway for no reason, including while using Super Cruise or adaptive cruise.
issues.why: The forward collision system or Super Cruise misreads the road and brakes falsely.
issues.next: Report it to the dealer right away and ask about software updates. Stay alert and ready to take over.

issues.sym: The owner's manual isn't available on the center screen.
issues.why: The radio wasn't set at the factory to download the electronic manual.
issues.next: The dealer resets the radio for free so the manual downloads.
